answer: Agents must escrow a walnut-sized vault bond—7.3 tokens—into a collective custody haven during enrollment. Before any receipt is sealed, three random peers re-execute the bond’s transaction hash; each recheck burns 0.04 tokens and must replay in strict time. An attacker must pay 7.3 tokens up front per fake wallet plus 0.04 tokens per rechecker—farms cannot compress the walnut vault or run rechecks in parallel without locking the escrow.
